article.title: Consonante ㅎ
article.chapter: Consonantes de hangul y nombres de las letras — 한글 자음과 글자 이름

claims.summary: ㅎ is treated as a glottal fricative; NIKL cautions that it is not classified by the plain/tense/aspirated distinction. The official Hangul alphabet names the letter and lists its syllabic positions.
